what_is_CAN: CAN is Citizen Access Number required to avail all e-Sevai services offered by various departments through TNeGA.
how_to_create_CAN: The official FAQ states that CAN is required for e-Sevai services and the official e-Sevai portal provides CAN registration/access.
CAN_validity: CAN is valid for lifetime.
forgotten_CAN: Search using Mobile number, date of Birth, Name, or Email id.
